entities.name: Luís Gonzaga Silva Pepeu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luís Gonzaga Silva Pepeu O. F. M. Cap. is a Brazilian Catholic prelate who has served as the first bishop of the newly created Diocese of Baturité since 2025, when he was appointed by Pope Leo XIV. A Capuchin friar and formerly the third bishop of Afogados da Ingazeira and the second archbishop of Vitória da Conquista, he was allowed to continue using the style of archbishop even though the new diocese is not an archdiocese.
